investment_theses.thesis: Binance hack creates structural bid for decentralized exchange tokens and staking protocols; BTC/ETH downside limited by institutional rebalancing into self-custody.
supporting_signals: Binance covering 90% of losses removes systemic contagion risk; phased withdrawals reduce panic cascade
CoinDesk: 'Bitcoin held up better than expected after Binance hack' (Strive CEO)
FBI DPRK attribution is known quantity; does not create additional tail risk
Institutions embracing staking suggests conviction in long-term hold thesis (CoinDesk)
investment_theses.counter_view: Remaining 10% uncovered losses could trigger retail capitulation if Binance misses withdrawal timeline; crypto exchange premium narrows as risk re-prices.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC perps 3-5x leverage, hedge with short-dated OTM BTC puts; long UNI/AAVE/CRV (DEX/staking exposure) relative to CEX tokens
